# Khmer knowledge levels (generated by restructure-khmer.mjs)

Entry format: `["key|alias2|alias3", "answer"]`, one per line. Lookup order: level 1, then 2, then 3, parts in number order; earlier entries win on duplicate keys.
Each part holds at most 1000 entries and 400000 bytes. When a part is full, start the next one.

| Level | Rule (entries sharing the same answer text) | Parts | Entries | Total bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | answer used by 1 entry | 32 | 21207 | 11725638 |
| 2 | answer shared by 2-5 entries | 13 | 10325 | 4736890 |
| 3 | answer shared by 6+ entries (generic template answers) | 31 | 24055 | 11876398 |

Where each entry came from before the move: `ORIGIN.tsv` (columns level, part, index, origin_file, origin_index).
Entries whose origin is `data.extra2.1.ts` or `data.extra2.2.ts` include PopQA-derived material (see ../../../DATA-NOTICE.md).
